build_FACT_VERIFICATION_DATASET: build a FactVerificationDataset instance to process FEVER claims and evidence from Wikipedia pages
create_GET_CHUNKS: create chunks of evidence sentences by reading claims and matching them against Wikipedia JSONL files
create_PROCESS_CHUNK: process a chunk of evidence sentences by matching them against a knowledge source and computing BLEU scores
create_NORMALIZE_TEXT: create normalized text by replacing tokenized bracket and punctuation symbols with their original characters
create_POSTPROCESS_METADATA: postprocess metadata from chunk processing to aggregate missing pages, exact matches, and fuzzy match statistics
